# PhysicsMass 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Physics](Blitz3D-Physics)

</div>


```blitzbasic
PhysicsMass:Void entity:Int32, kilograms:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | In | Int32 | required | The body. |
| `kilograms` | In | Float32 | required | More than 0. |

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Sets the mass of a dynamic body. How hard it is to push depends on it; how fast it falls does not. Bodies made from the standard shapes spread the mass over the volume, so a bigger body has more inertia.

## Differences

* The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
